aggregation: Equal case weight within each image, then equal image weight; each prefilter reported separately. Whole/common/border scores are separate.
image_interpretation: Decoded 8-bit RGB interpreted as sRGB; known embedded IEC 61966-2.1 sRGB profile accepted only by exact hash; untagged images explicitly assumed sRGB. No camera/profile/noise/optical-model claim. JPEG artifacts and previous demosaicing remain in the reference.
linearization: sRGB inverse transfer in float64, then optional filter, then float32 truth

prefilters.label: gaussian_0p6
prefilters.purpose: Sensitivity control for softened input; not a calibrated optical model.

research_continuation_screen.applies_to: each prefilter separately; supports only a C++ research parity prototype, not production admission

roi_rule: Four 128x128 native-pixel crops centered at floor(width/4), floor(3*width/4), floor(height/4), floor(3*height/4); no resampling; all ROIs fixed before algorithm scoring.

scopes.common_interior: exclude eight pixels on each edge

setup_revision_reason: Pre-evaluation guard found the same embedded standard sRGB profile in astronaut/chelsea. Accept exact reviewed profile before any scores; no metric, ROI, algorithm or continuation threshold changed.
